text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hereditary Telangiectasia-Ruptured Capillaries (HTRC) or Platelet Function Disorder (e.g., Glanzmann's thrombasthenia or Bernard-Soulier syndrome). The clinical presentation of mucocutaneous bleeding with normal platelet count and coagulation profile, along with a negative family history, suggests a qualitative platelet defect rather than a quantitative issue or clotting factor deficiency. I will need to review the requested skin images to look for telangiectasias or assess the nature of the petechiae further before finalizing the diagnosis.
